name: weight-wave
title: Weight Wave
description: Hover-reactive text effect that smoothly increases font weight with a falloff across neighboring characters. Requires a variable font.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: base-weight
props.description: Base font weight when not hovering.

props.name: influence-radius
props.description: Number of neighboring characters affected by the wave.

props.name: falloff-power
props.description: Power curve for weight falloff (higher = sharper falloff).
